applicability: Any large procedural build intended to be placed on unknown, uneven, sloped, cluttered, or deliberately floating terrain where screenshots/walkability need a coherent base plane.
core_rule: When terrain cannot be trusted, generate a designed artificial ground-zero platform/foundation under the whole intended walkable footprint rather than letting the base visually float over void or clip into ground.
components: continuous deck/floor plane using real floor ObjectIDs
perimeter skirt or edge band to show thickness/depth
support pylons, piers, legs, or underside structure
clear stair/ramp/elevator/portal access points where applicable
walkable clearance routes above the platform
service/utility zones moved away from primary pedestrian paths
not_universal: Do not add a ground-zero platform when terrain integration, natural ruins, landmark realism, or low-footprint placement is the explicit design goal.
failure_modes: Build appears to hover randomly over uneven ground.
Screenshots lack depth under the base.
Lower objects clip through terrain or disappear.
Pedestrian streets have no coherent datum plane.
